item.title: Version 0.1.13
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.13 ships full Strava API Agreement compliance and migrates the canonical site to runbar.run.
• Rolling 7-day Strava cache. Fetched activities are purged after one week per the Strava API Agreement; long-term history is preserved as derived weekly snapshots. • Disconnect now wipes Strava data. Settings → Sources → Disconnect deletes all locally cached Strava activities, not just the OAuth tokens. • Official Connect with Strava button across the popover, settings and onboarding. • Powered by Strava attribution in the popover footer. • View on Strava on every activity row — click to open the activity at strava.com. • AI coach disclaimer cites the Strava API Agreement and recommends a paid Gemini tier (free tier may use prompts to improve Google's models). • Site moves to runbar.run with /privacy /terms /contact pages.
Privacy summary unchanged: weekly aggregates only (distance, runs, elevation, target, progress, four-week history, streak, race countdown). Never activity names, timestamps, or GPS data.
